rationale: The evaluator feedback on iteration 3 candidate approved the cautious tuning trend of reducing kp and increasing kd to reduce steering oscillations and improve damping. It suggested that if oscillations persist, increasing kp to 4 and lowering kd to 8 might improve responsiveness and fine-tune damping, while reducing base speed to 1.5 could help if progress is low or unstable. Given the slalom track remains problematic with no finishes so far, I adopt these suggestions to try to improve stability and progress. I set kp to 4 to increase responsiveness slightly, kd to 8 to fine-tune damping, and base_speed to 1.5 to balance speed and control stability. Integral gain ki remains at 0.5 to maintain integral action. Sensor weights and line loss strategy remain unchanged as no issues have been reported with them. Geometry is unchanged, preserving the stable physical setup. I expect these changes to reduce residual oscillations, improve line tracking stability, and increase progress and completion rates, especially on challenging tracks like the slalom. I request measurements of completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify these effects in the next race.
